blind_control: blind_probe matches always_probe cost and signal-delivery waiting, then uses the prior and ignores the signal value

costly_probe.acceptance: Validate the entire batch, including execution at or before horizon, atomically. At most one probe and one commitment; probe must precede commitment in accepted order. Commitment is immutable on acceptance.
costly_probe.command_timing: First execution is sent_tick + delay + 1; FIFO, one command per tick, after earlier reservations.
costly_probe.grading: A completed trip by horizon earns max(0, target_value - penalty_per_tick * completion_tick) / normalization; all other outcomes earn zero. Scores are realized.
costly_probe.probe: Spend probe_energy at execution and produce the fixed episode signal. Signal equals terrain with signal_accuracy. Repeated log reads add no evidence.
costly_probe.telemetry: Briefing at tick 0 is known; every later event arrives at state_tick + delay. Reading is free.
costly_probe.trip: A completed route includes return home. Completion tick is commitment execution tick + route duration. Expenditure occurs on departure; insufficient energy drains battery to zero and fails the trip. No idle drain.

exact_enumeration.aggregate: Equal mean over four declared contexts; probability weighting within each context

gate: Exact selective aggregate strictly exceeds both always_probe and never_probe; selective chooses each behavior in at least one context; analytical and realized branch means match
next_step: Only if the mechanism gate passes: separately freeze a protected Harbor model pilot with clear instructions and scripting; no automatic expansion
policy_ties: selective skips probing on an equal value; route ties use lexical order (detour first)
replay: Evaluator-only terrain, signal and transcript retained for every exact and seeded row
scope: Scripted structural check of a route-decision abstraction, not the continuous rover or a model benchmark.

seeded_smoke.interpretation: Separate deterministic smoke matrix in this independent environment; not a hidden holdout or population estimate
